structured_output.analysis: The best grid is iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e). It sits just under the budget, so any upgrade has to be paid for. Most of the remaining loss is in MLP layers quantized at int3 or int2. The int3→int4 and int2→int3 bit costs come from the bits_delta_per_weight figures, about 1.0078 bits per weight per step. Two of the four proposals add no stored bits: one turns on act_order for every GPTQ-family method, and the other also swaps 27.up_proj to gptq_int4 while dropping 26.up_proj to rht_gptq_int2. The other two pay for MLP upgrades by switching some methods to group_size=256. I sized the upgrades so the savings should cover them even in the worst case, where the coarser methods sit on the smallest layers. The last round's refusals were caused by a rounded KL value, so the rationales below quote only exact record values.

proposals.name: act_order_all
proposals.rationale: Adds no stored bits. Sets act_order=true for every GPTQ-family method. Loss is concentrated in GPTQ-quantized MLP layers, e.g. 27.up_proj gptq_int3 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded] and 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633466 [E4c3f9b73e065]. Act-order quantizes the high-activation columns first, which should cut error in these outlier-heavy layers.

proposals.name: g256_int2int4_fund_14down
proposals.rationale: Moves 14.down_proj from rht_gptq_int2 0.00633466 [E4c3f9b73e065] to rht_gptq_int3 0.00181478 [E90bd4b2f3645]. The upgrade is paid for by setting group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int2 and rht_gptq_int4, which stores fewer scale bits.

proposals.name: g256_rht3_two_up_upgrades
proposals.rationale: Upgrades the two worst up_proj layers. 27.up_proj goes from gptq_int3 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded] to gptq_int4 0.00216589 [Efea8c18d2abc]. 3.up_proj goes from rht_gptq_int3 0.0064177 [E6f4f7ea296d5] to gptq_int4 0.00237732 [Ef4ee8cb4969e]. Both are paid for by group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3.

proposals.name: act_order_plus_27up_swap
proposals.rationale: Sets act_order=true and makes an equal-size swap between two same-shape layers. 27.up_proj goes from gptq_int3 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded] to gptq_int4 0.00216589 [Efea8c18d2abc]. 26.up_proj drops from rht_gptq_int3 to rht_gptq_int2. Its rht_gptq_int3 excess over floor is 0.004596772264602626 [E9b021f884acc]. This tests whether act_order lowers the cost of int2 enough to make the swap pay off.
